hypothesis: Combining channel-wise affine U4 K with scalar6 token-normalized ASTC V retains the pilot PPL screen while reducing logical bytes relative to asymmetric U4 K+V.
selection: Post-hoc combination selected after independent reproduction of old pilot and the negative mean-correction experiment; not a fresh confirmation dataset.
precise_tail: FP16 with genuine model error feedback; compress historical prefix once
model: SmolLM2-135M, fixed original BF16 weights widened to FP32, 30 layers
comparators: New same-Mac FP16 and asymmetric U4 reproductions
pilot_gate: aggregate PPL ratio to FP16 <=1.02; no per-document gate retroactively imposed
negative_outcome: Aggregate PPL ratio exceeds1.02, nonfinite outputs, or no logical-memory saving versus asymmetric U4. Even a pass is only a candidate; latency and physical memory remain unmeasured.
budget: One fixed hybrid, all four old documents,380 target losses. No tuning, corrections, mode selection, GPU encoder or new model.
